_comment: THE SOURCE IDENTITY THIS REPOSITORY IS WILLING TO BUILD.
The workflow resolves each upstream tag at build time and refuses to
continue unless it dereferences to exactly the commit named here. A git tag
is mutable — it can be moved, deleted and recreated against different code —
so 'we built the tag' is a weaker claim than it sounds. The commit is the
immutable identity, and this file is what makes the build assert it rather
These commits are independently corroborated: the withdrawn upstream images,
while they were still pullable, reported exactly these values at runtime —
build from these commits reproduces the releases that were withdrawn, rather
than merely something with the same version string.
Changing anything here is a deliberate act: it changes what we publish under

images.note: Ships the mc client alongside the server, as the upstream image did. The lab stack's healthcheck is `mc ready local`, which runs inside this image.
The client on its own, for the one-shot bucket initialiser.

base_images._comment: Pinned by digest so a rebuild resolves the same bytes. The builder is Debian-based and supplies the CA bundle the final stage copies; the runtime is Alpine because the stack's healthcheck is a CMD-SHELL and a distroless image has no shell.
